name: HR-Bench-TQA
description: HR-Bench-TQA is a question-answering benchmark designed to evaluate models' ability to answer text-based questions (TQA). It contains curated question–answer pairs that test comprehension, retrieval, and concise answer generation on the provided passages. The benchmark focuses on measuring correctness and fidelity of generated answers across a range of question types.
reputation: A small community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for QA fine-tuning and evaluation.
